title: Cowboys Beat Colts 27-23 on Late Javonte Williams Touchdown
excerpt: Dallas scored with 1:08 left to beat Indianapolis 27-23 in Week 9, as Dak Prescott threw for 335 yards and CeeDee Lamb caught 10 passes for 195 yards.
content:
The Dallas Cowboys beat the Indianapolis Colts 27-23 on Sunday, November 8, at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, scoring with 1:08 left to win their Week 9 game, according to the Associated Press.

Dallas trailed 23-20 with 1:37 left after Indianapolis kicker Spencer Shrader hit field goals from 59 and 50 yards in the final six minutes. Quarterback Dak Prescott then found Ryan Flournoy on a 46-yard pass, and three plays later Javonte Williams ran in from 1 yard out for the winning touchdown.

Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions. CeeDee Lamb caught 10 passes for 195 yards. Dallas outgained Indianapolis 508 yards to 271.

The win was far from clean: Dallas was flagged 14 times for 153 yards, lost two fumbles, and missed a 50-yard field goal. Rookie safety Caleb Downs sealed the win with an interception of Daniel Jones with 35 seconds left.

The win moved Dallas to 4-5 on the season. Indianapolis fell to 2-7 with its fifth straight loss. The Cowboys open a three-game homestand next Sunday against San Francisco.

Sources: Associated Press via ESPN; Indianapolis Colts.
